segments.text: Where's Dr. Alvarez's Aetna application? If answering that means opening a spreadsheet and three payer portals — keep watching. This is your whole practice in one view: every provider, every payer, one grid. Applications in flight show a live timeline, based on how long each payer actually takes. And when one runs long, Lanyard flags it — and tells you what it's doing about it.
Lanyard Health. Always know where it stands.
